correctness.rationale: The swap-fixed field is k(a,b) with a=x+y,b=xy, smooth plane D(a,b)=a^(q+1)-2(b^q+b)-lambda(a²-4b)^((q+1)/2), genus q(q-1)/2 for lambda!=±1. Inversion sends (a,b)->(a/b,1/b); invariant t=a²/b and w=a(b+1)/b reconstruct b quadratically and a rationally, giving exactly k(D)^inversion and 2T_h(w²/t-2)=t^m-lambda(t-4)^m. The inversion fixed points are q+1 distinct points with b=1; b=-1 does not contribute, and zero/infinity are exchanged. Tame Riemann–Hurwitz yields ((q-1)/2)^2. For q=3 the cubic discriminant and reduced Weierstrass invariants yield j=-lambda^6/[(lambda-1)^4(lambda+1)] and Hasse invariant vanishing only at lambda=0; derivative/pole multiplicities give degree-six separable map with branch partitions (6) and (4,1,1). All statements are over algebraic closure and exclude ±1; birational affine models are normalized.
